programs.title: Beginner 5×5
programs.summary: A classic barbell strength program for beginners. Squat every session and alternate two workouts of five sets of five, adding a little weight each time.

programs.title: Push Pull Legs 3-Day
programs.summary: A beginner-friendly way to start building muscle. One push, one pull and one leg day a week, each with a main lift and a few simple accessories.

programs.title: Fat Loss Gym Circuits
programs.summary: For gym beginners who want to lose fat and build fitness. Two full-body machine and dumbbell circuits plus two cardio sessions a week.

programs.title: Home Dumbbell Fat Loss
programs.summary: For beginners who want to lose fat at home with light dumbbells. Two full-body circuits alternate over four days a week, moving quickly between exercises with short rests.

programs.title: Beginner Full Body
programs.summary: A simple start in the gym for new lifters. Two full-body workouts, alternated three days a week, cover every major muscle with the main barbell lifts and a few machines.

programs.title: Bodyweight Basics
programs.summary: A first strength programme for complete beginners, using only your body weight. Three short full-body sessions a week build the squat, push, hinge and core basics, then step up to harder variations from week 4.

programs.title: Core Foundations
programs.summary: A gentle start to core training for beginners or anyone returning to exercise. Three short sessions a week teach bracing and control, then build to longer holds from week 4.

programs.title: Dumbbell Full Body for Beginners
programs.summary: For newcomers training at home with a pair of dumbbells. Two alternating full-body sessions, three days a week, build basic strength and good movement habits.

programs.title: Full Body 2-Day
programs.summary: For beginners with busy weeks. Two full-body gym sessions a week cover all the main movements, so you keep making progress on limited time.

programs.title: Indoor Cycling
programs.summary: For beginners building fitness on a bike. Each week has a steady ride, a stationary-bike interval session and short air-bike sprints, all gradually getting longer.

programs.title: Kettlebell Basics
programs.summary: For beginners with one kettlebell at home. Two alternating full-body sessions, three days a week, teach the squat, hinge, press and swing while building all-round fitness.

programs.title: Resistance Band Full Body
programs.summary: A beginner full-body programme you can do at home with a set of resistance bands. Three sessions a week alternate two workouts; use a stronger band or add reps as each gets easier.

programs.title: Rowing Machine Plan
programs.summary: For beginners who want a low-impact cardio routine on the rower. Two steady rows and one interval session a week, building from 15 to 25 minutes of steady rowing.

programs.title: Walking Plan
programs.summary: For anyone starting to exercise. Brisk walks five days a week, building from 20 to 45 minutes over six weeks.

programs.title: Run/Walk to 5K
programs.summary: For complete beginners who want to run 5 km. Three run/walk sessions a week, with the running intervals growing until you can run 25 minutes non-stop.

programs.title: Daily Mobility
programs.summary: A 15-minute mobility routine for every weekday, suitable for any fitness level. Two routines alternate to loosen hips, spine, hamstrings and shoulders.

programs.title: Desk Worker Mobility
programs.summary: For people who sit most of the day. Three sessions a week open up the hips, upper back, neck and shoulders and strengthen the muscles that support good posture.

programs.title: Bench Press Focus
programs.summary: For intermediate lifters who want to bring up their bench press. Three bench sessions a week — heavy, volume and paused — with squats, deadlifts and back work to keep the rest of the body strong.

programs.title: Intermediate Calisthenics
programs.summary: For people who can already do a few pull-ups and solid push-ups. An upper/lower split four days a week builds strength with harder bodyweight variations and a pull-up bar.

programs.title: Kettlebell Strength
programs.summary: For intermediate lifters with a pair of kettlebells who want to get stronger. Three heavy sessions a week built around cleans, presses, squats and hinges with low reps and full rest.

programs.title: Posterior Chain Strength
programs.summary: For intermediate lifters who want a stronger deadlift and a sturdier back, glutes and hamstrings. Three days a week built around the deadlift and other hip-hinge lifts, with squats and upper-body work for balance.

programs.title: Classic 5-Day Split
programs.summary: A traditional bodybuilding split for lifters with some experience. Chest, back, legs, shoulders and arms each get their own day, with plenty of volume for muscle growth.

programs.title: Dumbbell Arms & Shoulders
programs.summary: For intermediate lifters who want bigger arms and shoulders. Two focused dumbbell sessions a week, on Tuesday and Saturday, to add alongside another training plan.

programs.title: Dumbbell Glutes & Legs
programs.summary: For intermediate lifters who want stronger, more muscular legs and glutes at home. Three dumbbell sessions a week cover hip thrusts and hinges, squats, and single-leg work.

programs.title: Dumbbell Push Pull Legs
programs.summary: For intermediate lifters training at home with dumbbells. A classic push, pull and legs split over three days a week to build muscle across the whole body.

programs.title: Dumbbell Upper / Lower
programs.summary: For lifters with some experience and a set of dumbbells at home. Four sessions a week split into upper and lower body days to build muscle with moderate reps.

programs.title: Push Pull Legs 6-Day
programs.summary: A high-volume muscle-building split for experienced lifters. Push, pull and legs each come round twice a week, with a heavier and a lighter version of each day.

programs.title: Upper / Lower 4-Day
programs.summary: For lifters with some experience who want to build muscle and strength. Each half of the body is trained twice a week: one heavier day and one higher-rep day.

programs.title: HIIT Conditioning
programs.summary: For people with a base of fitness who want short, hard sessions. Three bodyweight interval workouts a week; work periods get longer and rests shorter after week three.

programs.title: Kettlebell Conditioning
programs.summary: For intermediate trainees who want to burn fat and build work capacity with a kettlebell. Swing intervals, a kettlebell complex and a circuit, three days a week with short rests.

programs.title: Hotel Room Workout
programs.summary: No-equipment training for when you're travelling, in the space beside a bed. Three sessions a week cover lower body, upper body and conditioning to keep your fitness ticking over.

programs.title: Hybrid Strength & Run
programs.summary: For people who want to get stronger and fitter at the same time. Two full-body barbell sessions and two runs a week: one interval session and one longer easy run.

programs.title: 10K Plan
programs.summary: For runners comfortable with 5 km who want to race 10 km. Four runs a week with alternating intervals and tempo runs, and a Sunday long run that builds to 12 km before race week.

programs.title: 5K Improver
programs.summary: For runners who can already run 5 km and want to get faster. Four runs a week: an easy run, intervals, a tempo run and a longer easy run; skip the easy run on a busy week.

programs.title: Half Marathon Base
programs.summary: For regular runners stepping up to the half marathon. Four runs a week, with a long run that builds gradually from 10 km to 18 km, cutback weeks every fourth week and a race at the end.

programs.title: Yoga Strength Flow
programs.summary: For people with some yoga or training experience who want strength and flexibility together. Three sessions a week hold standing, balance and backbend poses for time, with longer holds from week 4.

programs.title: Calisthenics Skills
programs.summary: For advanced trainees chasing the handstand, L-sit, planche and front and back levers. Four days a week pair skill holds with the strength work behind them, with longer holds and harder variations from week 6.

programs.title: Powerbuilding 4-Day
programs.summary: For advanced lifters who want to get stronger and bigger at the same time. Each day opens with heavy, low-rep work on a main lift, followed by moderate-rep accessories for size.

programs.title: Dumbbell Hypertrophy 5-Day
programs.summary: For experienced lifters with a full set of dumbbells who want to maximise muscle growth. An upper/lower block followed by push, pull and legs gives every muscle two hard sessions a week.

programs.title: Advanced Core
programs.summary: Demanding core training for experienced trainees with a pull-up bar. Three sessions a week cover anti-extension, rotation and hanging strength with moves such as dragon flags, toes-to-bar and L-sits.
